question: Which irreducible laws of Illustrator, Rive, Cavalry, After Effects, Harmony, Spine, and Figma survive on a single living SVG organism, and which first-class claims are mutually exclusive?
verdict: Keep 10 Gasper laws. Refuse layers, Merge, clip-FSM, pen, bones, variants. Transport is AE's one stolen law. Stage|Graph is a view split. Nodes are the Cook. Offsets not overwrites.
invariants: One embedding, one d, one clock, one tau
Five compilers, not four authoring worlds
